Bureau Veritas 
 Accredited Certification Body · IAF Member
 
 CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION 
 
 Certificate No: ORG-1003 Page 1 of 2 
 
 This is to certify that the management system of 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. 
 
 Salt Lake, Kolkata, India 
 
 has been assessed by this certification body and found to conform to the requirements of
 
 ISO 45001:2018 
 
 SCOPE OF REGISTRATION 
 
 Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) of infrastructure projects including water supply, sewerage & drainage, roads &
 highways, bridges, buildings, industrial structures, and related civil engineering works.
 
 Initial Certification Date 2022-07-16 
 
 Valid Until 2028-09-16 
 Certification Body Bureau Veritas 
 
 IAF Accreditation Yes - IAF MLA Signatory 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CERT-003 Page 1 of 2

[TABLE]
Initial Certification Date | 2022-07-16
Valid Until | 2028-09-16
Certification Body | Bureau Veritas
IAF Accreditation | Yes - IAF MLA Signatory

SCHEDULE OF AUDITS 
 
 Audit Type Date Lead Auditor Findings 
 
 Initial Certification 2022-07-16 Dr. R. Mehta 0 major, 2 minor NCs - closed
 Surveillance Audit 1 2024-03-15 Dr. R. Mehta 0 major, 1 minor NC - closed 
 
 Surveillance Audit 2 2025-02-20 Mr. S. Kapoor 0 major, 0 minor NCs 
 
 Re-certification 2028-01-10 TBD Scheduled 
 
 CONDITIONS 
 1. This certificate remains the property of Bureau Veritas and must be returned on demand.
 
 2. The certificate is valid only when the annual surveillance audit fees are paid and audits are conducted.
 3. Any change in the scope of registration must be communicated to the certification body.
 4. Use of the certificate in a misleading manner shall result in immediate suspension.
 
 This certificate was issued in accordance with the procedures of Bureau Veritas and is subject to the terms and conditions of the certification agreement dated
 2022-07-16. 
 
 
 Dr. R. Mehta 
 Principal Auditor
